title: Track openmls PR #2351 (export CommitIn and FramedContentAuthData)
description:
Opened 2026-11-26 against openmls/openmls from branch
export-commitin-and-authdata: makes `CommitIn` and
`FramedContentAuthData` public (fields stay private) plus a CHANGELOG
entry. mimid needs both to decode a SemiPrivateMessageContent
(bead mimid-1wgh.4.79.1).

Until it lands, Cargo.toml pins the openmls git rev
64f9eab2fad09ed2ec42d0facab183082b6b458c on mimid's own branch
mimid-0.9.2, which carries the same two commits.

## What to watch for

- Review comments asking for a different shape. A likely one: expose an
  accessor rather than the type, since mimid only needs to deserialize.
  mimid reads the signature out of the received bytes
  (`wire::ContentSpans`) rather than from FramedContentAuthData, so an
  accessor-only answer would still work for the signature but not for
  decoding the content.
- If it is rejected, the pin stays on mimid-0.9.2 indefinitely and that
  becomes a maintenance cost to record, not a blocker.

## Done when

The PR is merged and Cargo.toml points at an upstream rev or release
instead of mimid-0.9.2, or the PR is closed and this bead records why
with the pin made deliberate.
